description: This Dart file implements a login screen widget for a Flutter app, supporting login via password or OTP, with additional functionality for password reset. It manages user input, interacts with authentication APIs, handles OTP cooldowns and lockouts, and navigates to the dashboard upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a UI for user login via password or OTP. It includes form handling, mode switching, OTP request and verification, password reset, and navigation upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginMode
classes.description: An enum to switch between login methods: password and OTP.

methods.name: _loginWithPassword
methods.description: Handles user login using password, managing validation, API interaction, session storage, and error handling.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for the provided phone number, manages cooldown state, and handles rate limiting errors.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndLogin
methods.description: Verifies the entered OTP, manages lockout and cooldown states, and handles login success or errors.

methods.name: _passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates a password reset by sending OTP, handling validation and loading state.

methods.name: _passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset with OTP and new password, updating session state and handling errors.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up timers and controllers to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: _startOtpCooldown
methods.description: Starts a countdown timer during which OTP resend is disabled.

methods.name: _startOtpLockout
methods.description: Starts a lockout timer disabling OTP requests after multiple failed attempts.
